rules: Teach something real in every post. Give the actual answer, do not tease and withhold.
Lead with what the business owner gets or loses, not with EPG.
Short sentences. Concrete nouns. No filler adjectives like 'stunning', 'powerful', 'cutting-edge', 'game-changing'.
Never use em dashes or double hyphens. Use commas, colons, or split the sentence.
No ALL CAPS words. At most one exclamation mark per caption.
At most 3 emoji per caption. None is fine.
The guarantee (top 3 in 90 days or money back) and the free audit are the only offers to mention. Never invent client counts, revenue figures, or star ratings.
Do not quote fake statistics. Say 'nearly all' or 'most' instead of inventing a percentage.
